headline: Multiple Fronts Flare as Bases Exchange Control
war_summary: Since the 06:10 edition the conflict has sharpened on a half‑dozen sectors. Godcrofts remains the hottest flashpoint, logging twelve ownership changes in the last two hours and a combined casualty rate of roughly 70 Colonial and 65 Warden losses per hour. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest theatre, has stayed quiet for the past six hours — no flips since 03:10 — but casualties stay extreme at about 380 Colonial and 420 Warden per hour. Fishermans Row continues its intense churn with eleven flips in the last six hours and accelerating losses near 400 Colonial and 590 Warden per hour. Stonecradle, previously static, has recorded four new flips in the last two hours and sustained high attrition (≈255 Colonial, 331 Warden per hour). Stlican Shelf, after a burst of eight flips earlier, shows no fresh changes in the last six hours but retains a high 24‑hour turnover of thirty‑one events. Linn Mercy added a single flip in the past six hours, with casualties climbing to roughly 400 Colonial and 610 Warden per hour. Callahan’s Passage, quiet for six hours, now registers three flips. Farranac Coast and Mooring County remain largely unchanged, while Viper Pit shows modest activity. All other sectors report no ownership activity.
